trigger: Start ROOM capture with 4 people in room
ui_state: RoomConsentRollCall sheet before record
copy_direction: Each person says name + "I consent" or scans QR — under DPDP each is a data principal
design_answer: On-tape consent roll-call before recording; under-18 gate included — see C-10
states_to_generate: Capture with roll-call / missing-consent blocked / all-consented ready

trigger: Browse campaign where contributor's profile already over-collected

states_to_generate: CoverageFullState screen + redirect card row

trigger: Browse → brief → another contributor fills last slots while you decide

states_to_generate: Card flips to filled / brief honour-notice / toast while viewing

case_name: Interrupted room take — call at min 19 of 25
trigger: Phone call / app backgrounded / battery death during continuous ROOM take
ui_state: SessionInterrupted: local persistence + resume CTA; highest-stakes failure (₹220 + 4 people's evening)

design_answer: Local persistence + resume within 24h surfaced from Home active-assignment row

states_to_generate: SessionInterrupted screen + resume from Home row + expiry notice

trigger: User revokes DPDP consent after clip paid and settled
ui_state: ConsentRevokedPostPayment receipt: data deleted confirmation
copy_direction: Data deleted. Money not clawed back. Show ledger row struck as deleted with settled amount retained.
design_answer: Revocation confirm screen + ledger detail with deletion marker + settled row retained
states_to_generate: Revocation receipt + ledger row struck as deleted + settled retained

trigger: Auto-check flags synthetic audio / spoofing
ui_state: Verification hold — explained / appealable — promote existing SpoofingVerificationHold
copy_direction: Explain what flagged / what happens next / timeline / appeal path — never silent penalty

case_name: Rarity gaming — contributor claims scarce dialect
trigger: Selects Vidarbha Marathi 1.6× but acoustic/dialect signal mismatches / location inconsistent
ui_state: Dialect mismatch flag before payout — honest check not accusation
copy_direction: We detected a dialect mismatch — your Marathi was paid at base rate. Verify dialect for future bonuses.
design_answer: Dialect mismatch adjusts pay breakdown to base — honest check before payout
states_to_generate: Flagged Review row + pay breakdown adjusts to base + location-dialect confirm prompt

case_name: Silent room participant — one of four never speaks
trigger: ROOM 4-person take submitted — one speaker has 0 seconds
ui_state: Room take review flags silent speaker — clarifies pay eligibility
copy_direction: Name it: ""One speaker didn't speak — this take needs all 4 voices to be valid. Retake or remove?"" + pay consequence shown
design_answer: Room review shows 4-lane speaker timeline with one lane empty + retake-all vs adjust
states_to_generate: Room Review with 4-lane timeline (one empty) + retake-all CTA

case_name: Quality grade dispute — contributor appeals pay-reducing grade
trigger: Validator grades 4.5 threshold reduces quality bonus; contributor disagrees
ui_state: Bounded-window dispute path — same accountability class as LokAI stop taxonomy
copy_direction: Time-boxed appeal CTA on rejected/under-review row + expected timeline + what evidence is re-checked
design_answer: Bounded appeal window (7 days) → escalation to 3rd reviewer → honest result state
states_to_generate: RejectedTask with Appeal CTA (7d) + Under appeal — 3rd reviewer + result

case_name: Minor/guardian consent — family dinner includes under-18
trigger: ROOM roll-call asks ""anyone under 18 present?"" → yes
ui_state: Minor gate in roll-call — exclude speaker or capture guardian consent on tape
copy_direction: Block + explain; no data retained; offer to re-take without minor
design_answer: Block if minor present — exclude speaker or capture guardian consent on tape
states_to_generate: RoomConsentRollCall minor branch + blocked state + exclusion/consent CTA

trigger: Network drops after Review → Submit — 3 clips queued
ui_state: Local queue banner: ""3 clips saved — waiting for network."" Trust moment — do not discard
copy_direction: Show persistent offline queue reachable from Home — not only toast
design_answer: Local queue persists + retry CTA; trust moment not discard
states_to_generate: Offline queue row on Home/UploadQueue screen + retry CTA + preserved take count

case_name: Partial rejection — one clip fails among 8
trigger: One clip rejected · 7 accepted in LINES/SCENARIO
ui_state: Repair Studio — keep accepted · wire reason to validator taxonomy
copy_direction: Shared rejection taxonomy (noise · clipping · wrong language · script deviation · overlap · duration · synthetic · consent missing) — one taxonomy both directions
design_answer: Preserve accepted clips; isolate failed clip with validator taxonomy reason in native language + example
states_to_generate: Repair Studio matrix with flagged clip + reason + example + retake single CTA

trigger: Tap record without permission
ui_state: Permission prime with why + path to settings
copy_direction: Explain why needed — not generic system dialog
design_answer: Permission prime explains why + deep link to OS settings

trigger: Room ambient exceeds threshold during Capture
ui_state: Pause + guidance — don't discard
copy_direction: Pause overlay with guidance + level meter + resume — do not discard

trigger: <20% on ROOM format at Brief

trigger: No clips to grade
